page_title: ATA 1-0 LEC | Atalanta v Lecce 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The booking goes to Remi Oudin (Lecce).
90+5' The referee Gianluca Manganiello awards Emil Holm (Atalanta) a yellow card.
90+4' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+2' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Emil Holm (Atalanta) replaces Matteo Ruggeri.
90+2' That will be all from Ademola Lookman who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).

90+2' Marcin Listkowski (Lecce) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
90+2' Remi Oudin (Lecce) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+1' Remi Oudin (Lecce) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90' A sweet pass finds Remi Oudin (Lecce) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
88' Lecce keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession.
86' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
84' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
84' Substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is replaced by Marcin Listkowski (Lecce).
84' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Valentin Gendrey is replaced by Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce).
83' Substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Atalanta).
82' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
82' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
78' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) finds himself some space inside the penalty box and immediately unleashes a first-time effort. The shot sails well wide of the right post.
77' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nikola Krstovic.
77' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
75' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
74' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will deliver the corner kick.

73' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Hamza Rafia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Ahmed Touba (Lecce) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
70' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

70' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
69' Handball! A player from Lecce handled the ball.
67' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece.

66' Wladimiro Falcone was forced into action to thwart Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
64' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Scamacca will be replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
64' Here comes a substitution. Davide Zappacosta is given a rest as he is replaced by Nadir Zortea (Atalanta).
64' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
64' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Wladimiro Falcone.
62' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

58' 1 - 0 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Wladimiro Falcone had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
58' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar.
58' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
57' A goal, which was scored by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce), was disallowed due to offside.
55' Mohamed Kaba swings the cross over. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
54' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
53' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

53' Remi Oudin (Lecce) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
52' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.

51' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
49' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
47' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle as Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
43' Some patient build-up play from Lecce as they look to unlock the defence.
41' A nice individual effort by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
39' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' A raking crossfield pass from Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
38' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) picks up an injury.
36' Ederson (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
32' The ball is cleared after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
28' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
27' Lecce take a short corner kick.
26' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
24' Atalanta have a corner.

23' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Atalanta get a corner.
23' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
21' Ederson (Atalanta) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
18' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) sends a long ball forward to Davide Zappacosta, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
15' The foul by Ederson (Atalanta) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
14' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) hit the right post with his blast from close range after receiving a cross from the resulting free kick.

14' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gianluca Manganiello blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Atalanta earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
13' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads well wide of the right post from close in.
9' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
6' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
4' Ederson (Atalanta) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
3' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The Atalanta players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello was nominated as the referee for this game.
